confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on 2026-dated Pai and Thailand cost-of-living guides, which are aggregated estimates rather than official price data. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: no Pai-specific cocktail or wine price was found, so they are bounded from Thai bar price ranges and the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass slightly above cocktail). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Pai's tourist-town context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, and no accommodation searches were run. Hotel 3-star is the least certain anchor.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pai-specific cost guides (March 2026) for inexpensive meals, mid-range dinner for two, cappuccino and beer, adjusted for a small tourist town. Thailand-wide and Chiang Mai/Bangkok 2026 guides were used for drink price ranges, with Pai assumed to sit at or below Chiang Mai levels. Accommodation is a general SEA small-tourist-town estimate.
